Project.title: Project
Project.description: Represents a user-owned project with metadata, status, and description

userId.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of the project owner

name.description: The title or name of the project

description.description: Optional detailed overview or markdown notes for the project

status.description: Current status stage of the project

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp or Firestore server timestamp when the project was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp or Firestore server timestamp when the project was last updated

/projects/{projectId}.description: Private project documents strictly restricted to their respective owner
